name: Mirth Connect
what_it_is: An open-source healthcare integration engine that translates, filters, routes, and transforms messages between disparate health information systems via configurable channels with source connectors, transformation steps, and destination connectors.
constraints: Source code for v4.6+ not publicly available; last open-source is 4.5.2
Default 256 MB heap; must be raised for production
Default admin/admin credentials with no enforced password policy
Administrator GUI requires Java Web Start or launcher
notable_absences: No FHIR connector in open-source (commercial extension)
